settings.title: Serving Our Neighbors with Pride Since 2018

settings.editor: At Mid Lakes HVAC, we aren’t a big regional franchise—we’re your local neighbors. With our headquarters located right here in Loganville, Georgia, our family-owned business provides fast, reliable, and honest HVAC solutions to homeowners across our local community.

Whether you need 24/7 emergency AC repair, a high-efficiency Carrier® installation, or crawl space encapsulation, our Loganville technicians deliver 75+ years of combined experience right to your door.
Coverage
We provide full-service residential heating, cooling, and home efficiency solutions to Loganville and the surrounding regional areas:
Loganville, GA
Snellville, GA
Monroe, GA
Grayson, GA
Lawrenceville, GA
Winder, GA
Social Circle, GA
Don’t see your town listed above? Give our office a call at (678) 776-0591. We’ll be happy to check our schedule and see if we can accommodate your home!
Services

settings.title: What We Offer in Your Neighborhood

settings.editor: Whether you need urgent midnight repairs or long-term efficiency upgrades, Mid Lakes HVAC delivers reliable, full-service home comfort solutions straight to your door.
Live after-hours dispatch for sudden central AC and heating breakdowns—no automated runarounds.
High-efficiency heat pumps, air conditioners, and furnaces backed by free upfront estimates and our Parts & Labor Guarantee.
Precision, single or multi-zone heating and cooling for room additions, garages, or spaces without ductwork.
Heavy-duty vapor barriers, active dehumidification, and mold prevention to protect your home’s foundation and air quality.
Blown-in insulation and whole-home moisture control to balance sticky air and slash monthly energy bills.
Join over 300 local members receiving two annual system tune-ups, priority emergency dispatch, and exclusive repair discounts.
FAQs

items.item_title: How quickly can a technician get to my home if I’m outside Loganville?
How does after-hours and weekend service work?
Do you offer free estimates on replacement systems in all service areas?

settings.editor: Response times depend on daily technician routing, but our central Loganville location allows us to reach surrounding communities across Walton and Gwinnett Counties promptly.
When you call outside of our standard Monday–Friday office hours, our 24/7 after-hours call service routes your call directly to an on-call team member so we can dispatch help when you need it most.
Yes! We provide 100% free estimates on new Carrier® system installations across our entire coverage footprint.
